advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer jreese15: Kimani Vidal + Ja'Kobi Lane for A.J. Brown.
Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.3 points a week) and drop Matt Hibner.

reasons: You're 15-7 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 24%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 1st of 8 contenders (175.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 24%, 21%, 24%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 24% to 26%, and your lineup comes out 1.3 points a week ahead overall. Kimani Vidal + Ja'Kobi Lane add 1.3 points a week for you today, but A.J. Brown is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 1,912, get 1,845), and it barely changes their lineup (-1.0 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 21% and 24% to 21% and 24%.
You have 2 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Dallas Goedert is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (3.4 points a week).
Jordan Love's trade value has dropped 14% in 30 days.
Chase Brown's trade value has dropped 36% in 30 days.
Bryce Young's trade value has dropped 42% in 30 days.
C.J. Stroud's trade value has dropped 13% in 30 days.
